title: Why Unitree’s 460% IPO Stock Pop Wasn’t Unusual in China
summary: Humanoid robot maker Unitree’s 460% surge in its Shanghai stock market debut on Wednesday was the latest in a series of eye-watering first trading-day pops fetched by some recent tech initial public offerings in mainland China’s stock market.
